exposure: Full siblings discordant for Tourette's and chronic tic disorders (TD/CTD)
outcome: Risk of Tourette's and chronic tic disorders (TD/CTD)
cohort: 3,026,861 singletons born in Sweden between 1973 and 2003
finding: Impaired fetal growth, preterm birth, breech presentation, and cesarean section were associated with a higher risk of TD/CTD, independent of shared family confounders.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with a higher risk of Tourette's and chronic tic disorders.
